title: Demon and Ice Sorceress
description: A blue demonic figure with large horns and a red-lined black cape stands in a glowing arched stone doorway, gesturing with one hand. To the right, a pale elf-like woman with long silver hair in a dark ornate dress holds a glowing staff while standing on ice, as a woman in a red and black dress kneels on the stone floor between them drawing a magical circle.
prompt: A towering blue-skinned demon with large curved horns and flowing red-lined cape stands within a glowing ancient stone archway covered in runes and hanging ice crystals, gesturing toward a ritual circle. In the center a woman in a red and black dress kneels drawing symbols on the floor. To the right a beautiful silver-haired elf sorceress in a dark ornate gothic dress stands on broken ice holding a glowing staff, dramatic purple and blue fantasy atmosphere, detailed digital painting
